about_title: Reliable Partner for Consistent Polymer Raw Material Supply
about_p1: Kontinent Plast s.r.o. based in Brno was established to distribute high quality polymers and granulates to the European industrial market. We operate in the plastic industry providing sales of Polypropylene, Polyethylene, HDPE, LDPE, PVC and engineering thermoplastics.
about_p2: We supply national and international manufacturing clientele throughout Europe. We offer customers a full technological and logistics service - from technical consultation and customs clearance to direct delivery into your production silos and warehouses.
about_p3: We guarantee consistent supply quality, backup stocks of polymers in warehouse and a broad portfolio of granulates. Our constant aim is supply chain optimization and eliminating production downtime risk for our injection moulding and extrusion partners.
about_feat1_desc: We keep critical polymer grades in stock for smooth production runs without delays.
about_feat2_desc: Complete customs clearance, origin certification and delivery by silo tankers or pallets.
about_feat3_desc: Every production lot is delivered with factory test certificate complying with ISO, ASTM and DIN.
